1879064389.name: Passage of Nature
1879064389.desc: Allows you to track the presence of nearby beasts and other natural creatures.

1879073221.name: Shatter Arms
1879073221.desc: Your companion weakens their target's offence.

1879089861.name: Guide to West Angmar
1879089861.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to West Angmar.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879090245.name: Roar
1879090245.desc: Roar of rage. When is sometimes? Sometimes is next.

1879104837.name: Headbreaker
1879104837.desc: A strong blow from the Defiler's staff.  Contact with a Defiler's staff can poison many denizens of Middle-earth.

1879136965.name: Time-Out
1879136965.desc: After the defeat of your opponent, you calm down and prepare for your next engagement.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a Defeat Response</rgb>

1879138629.name: Tenderize
1879138629.desc: A sharp blow from the Defiler's staff. May briefly daze the target.

1879146821.name: Spider's Guile (Tactical)
1879146821.desc: This fellowship skill does minor direct tactical damage to your target, then more damage over time and can contribute to fellowship manoeuvres.

1879212101.name: Application of 'Coveritol'
1879212101.desc: Instructions: Apply gently, but firmly to target's face. One application per usage. Please see your Minstrel if conditions persist. WARNING: Target must remove all hats, helms, and other headgear for Coveritol to function properly.

1879213893.name: A Snail out of its Shell (Ranged)
1879213893.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's scales, tearing them loose and exposing what lies beneath.

1879217093.name: Coda of Melody
1879217093.desc:
A Finishing Skill that deals enormous AoE damage to foes and AoE healing to allies.

 <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Ballads from the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879233861.name: War-steed: Light
1879233861.desc: The Courser is a lightly armoured War-steed. Fast and agile, the Courser provides the greatest speed and maneuverability on the battlefield, trading Endurance and Armour to retain their nimbleness.

1879242309.name: Radiant Burst
1879242309.desc: You hurl a lens toward your target distracting and potentially dismounting them. The glimmering light will attract a murder of crows to hamper the target's movement once the distraction dissipates.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill cannot be used on a target under the effects of 'Murder of Crows' the movement reducing effect applied by Radiant Burst.</rgb>

1879244869.name: Assault of the Eorlingas
1879244869.desc: A violent strike against the target that focuses on your offensive capability, this skill is executed at range.\n\n<rgb=#66ffff>Applies the Lance effect to you. Skill of the Eorlingas becomes Lancer's Charge.</rgb>

1879245637.name: Fixation of Flame
1879245637.desc: The slow nature of a flame that consumes is coupled with runes of longevity to bring about a long slow burn on an enemy target. This effect can stack up to three times.

1879246021.name: Impale
1879246021.desc:
You violently stab at your opponent, doing additional damage to enemies wounded by your bleeds.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Ignores 30% of the target's mitigations.

Does 25% additional damage per bleed, which ignores all mitigations.</rgb>

1879250757.name: Sign of Power: Inspiration
1879250757.desc: The Lore-master marks an enemy and allows his allies and their mounts to draw inspiration from fighting the marked foe.

1879257541.name: Warning Shot
1879257541.desc: A powerful toss which aggravates your target, forcing them to attack you.

1879267141.name: Kick
1879267141.desc: You kick out at your enemy.

1879267909.name: Song of Unity
1879267909.desc: The Minstrel sings a song that allows them to instantly reap the benefit of two ballads and unlock their Coda

1879271749.name: Redirect
1879271749.desc: Strike the enemy and reflect a portion of their damage back at them.\n\n <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires the use of Retaliation or Whirling Retaliation</rgb>

1879290949.name: Feral Strikes
1879290949.desc: You make a savage double attack that is difficult to parry or evade. The first attack will remove a Corruption from the target and the second has a chance to remove a corruption from the target.

1879295429.name: Piercing Trap
1879295429.desc: Places a snare to slow the enemy and cause damage over time.\n\nTrap remains for 60 seconds after being placed.

1879302597.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Oath-bound)
1879302597.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879304005.name: Barbed Arrow
1879304005.desc: Your arrow can cause a wound that bleeds.

1879315141.name: Snap Shot - Ambush with Flame
1879315141.desc: When given time to prepare, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879357637.name: Journey to Bâr Thorenion
1879357637.desc: Journey to the Allegiance Hall: Bâr Thorenion

1879358789.name: Goat of the Harvest Sky
1879358789.desc: A goat from the Farmers Faire.

1879368645.name: Toffee Goat Kid
1879368645.desc: Brings out a toffee goat kid to keep you company.

1879374533.name: Return to Skarháld
1879374533.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Zhélruka Dwarf Clan, you're able to quickly return to Skarháld. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879385157.name: Golden Barn Owl
1879385157.desc: Brings out a golden barn owl to keep you company.

1879411781.name: Come At Me
1879411781.desc: Often honing their methods in uncouth tavern brawls, Brawlers are known to challenge all comers - one at a time, or all together.\n\nPBAoE Taunt

1879459397.name: Test Melee Tactical VPS
1879459397.desc: Does fixed effect to test buffs and mitigations.

1879490501.name: Staff Strike
1879490501.desc: Strike hard with your staff. If your pet is flanking the enemy, you will deal bonus damage.

1879492165.name: Condemned
1879492165.desc: Condemn your foe with fell mark, weakening them for all your allies to see.

1879495365.name: Memory of Hope
1879495365.desc: A Memory of Hope can be used to restore the Morale of an ally.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>Restores 70% of your target's Morale.</rgb>

1879506629.name: Prepare: Frost Breath
1879506629.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, you expel the chilling gelid wind from your lungs, dealing damage in a cone before you. Targets struck by the breath may move significantly slower.

1879526597.name: Prepare: Wisp of Shadow
1879526597.desc: Servants of the Umbral Pall use wisps of shadow to harm their enemies.

1879532485.name: Têtikir Cry
1879532485.desc: You loose a battle cry, dealing Light damage to nearby foes.
